text: Because Dummett's anti-realist rejects verification-transcendent truth values, he holds that the law of excluded middle is unwarranted for undecidable statements, and so favors revising classical logic in favor of ___ logic.
explanation: Anti-realism ties truth to what could in principle be verified, so for statements we can neither prove nor refute there is no ground to assert 'P or not-P'. Dummett therefore endorses intuitionistic logic, which rejects unrestricted excluded middle and double-negation elimination. This makes his anti-realism a revisionary program in logic, not merely in metaphysics.
